setup.title: ⚙️ Pratic Bot Setup
setup.desc: Follow the steps to configure the ticket system.
setup.steps:
**Steps:**
1. `/config logs #channel`
2. `/config transcripts #channel`
3. `/config staff @role`
4. `/config categoria #category`
5. `/painel criar`
6. `/painel enviar`

wizard.author: Configuration Center
wizard.title: ⚙️ Configuration Panel
wizard.desc:
> Configure everything **without memorizing commands**.
> Click the buttons below to open each section.

logs.title: 📝 Logs Channel
logs.body:
**What is it for?**
> Where ticket events appear (opened, claimed, closed).

**Tip:**
> Use the 🪄 **Auto-create channels** button to set everything up at once.

transcripts.title: 📄 Transcripts Channel
transcripts.body:
**What is it for?**
> When a ticket closes, the `.html` and `.txt` history is sent here.

category.title: 📁 Category
category.body:
**What is it for?**
> Where ticket channels are created.

**Tip:**
> A dedicated category keeps your server tidy.

staff.title: 🛡️ Staff Roles
staff.hint:
> The roles above are already **pre-selected** in the menu below.
> Add or remove freely — click away to save.

**Tip:** you can pick up to **10 roles** at once.

language.title: 🌐 Language
language.body: > Choose which language the bot speaks on this server.
